description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Tesla is hiring a Software Engineer to develop internal project management applications for its Construction organization. The role focuses on backend services and APIs supporting project accounting, labor management, financial reporting, and analytics, while improving workflows and application reliability.
Software Engineer designing backend services and APIs for project-management operations, improving business workflows and application reliability

Responsibilities:
• Design and develop services and APIs that support project management operations, with a primary emphasis on backend systems and business workflows (frontend experience is a plus)
• Learn the business domain, understand how users interact with applications, and identify how tools can create value for Tesla
• Provide timely customer support to help ensure application reliability and meet user expectations
• Identify opportunities to simplify and improve business workflows
• Review applications and data tools with the team and provide constructive feedback
• Participate in end-to-end process reviews and communicate impacts to the team
• Share knowledge across software and data-oriented teams

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience
• 1–2 years of backend web application development, building services and APIs
• Proficiency in C#, including a solid understanding of OOP, async/await, LINQ, and core language features
• Experience with .NET, including ASP.NET Core and Web API development
• Experience with Entity Framework Core and SQL Server, including basic database design and queries
• Understanding of RESTful API design
• Experience writing unit and integration tests with xUnit or NUnit
• Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), Docker, and CI/CD pipelines
• Basic understanding of performance considerations, logging, and scalability

Preferred:
• Azure preferred
• Frontend experience is a plus
